description: This file contains helper functions for handling relationships between modules in SuiteCRM, including retrieving relationship properties, querying relationships, saving relationships, and retrieving linked records. It serves as a utility module for managing CRUD operations and SOAP-based interaction with module relationships.

methods.name: check_for_relationship
methods.description: Checks if a given module has a relationship with other modules and returns the relationship table name if found.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the properties of a specific relationship between two modules, such as the join table and related keys.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships
methods.description: Fetches all viewable relationships between two modules, returning related records with optional filtering, pagination, and count.

methods.name: retrieve_modified_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves modified relationships between two modules within a date range, optionally returning specific fields.

methods.name: server_save_relationships
methods.description: Saves a list of relationship records, with handling for additions, modifications, and deletions based on timestamps.

methods.name: get_from_statement
methods.description: Extracts the FROM clause from a SQL query string, excluding ORDER BY and SELECT parts.

methods.name: retrieve_relationship_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to retrieve the relationship records between two modules, including necessary joins.

methods.name: get_module_link_field
methods.description: Returns the name of the link field between two modules if it exists.

methods.name: get_linked_records
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of records linked to a specific record in another module via their relationship link.
